<div class="card-body">
'''Meteor Impact?''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">隕石でも落ちたのかな？</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">2フォース消費して屋外の惑星位置に配備する。同じ惑星上のキャラクターを1人目標とする。キャラクターは惑星から離れたり、ウーティーニー・エフェクトから遠ざかることができない。目標がウーティーニー・エフェクトに到着したらウーティーニー・エフェクトはロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Meteor-Impact-Category1Games-820s.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「近くに隕石が落ちたみたいだ。調べてから帰るよ。すぐ済むと思う」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Meteor Impact?.

'''Card text:'''
Spend 2 Force to deploy to an outdoor planet location. Target one character on the same planet. The character cannot leave the planet or move farther away from the Utinni Effect. When the target reaches the Utinni Effect, the Utinni Effect is lost.

'''Lore:'''
“It looks like a meteorite fell nearby. I’ll check it out before coming back. I don’t think it’ll take long.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses “outdoor planet location” and ロストする (“is lost”) for the arrival sentence.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Meteor Impact?]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
